name: Terrarium Order of Operations
description: Discover a hidden ecological dependency order by watching each inoculation change the living terrarium, then certify a run in which every habitat reaches full bloom. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state access, terminal, shell, Python, URL edits, reload/navigation, extensions, or external applications. Watch the transient root echoes, remember what each retry revealed, and find the one six-capsule order that brings every habitat to full bloom.

metadata.source_notes: Grounded in the Eyezmaze GROW series' click-permutation, visually communicated dependency, and all-items-at-max contract. The terrarium, causal graph, art, controls, generation, and replay grader are original.
metadata.notes: Each local retry preserves the generated causal world while clearing the attempted order. The server and exported verifier independently replay the final visible inoculation transcript; no client completion flag is trusted.
